$comment: Exceptions that Main integrity accepts. Add an entry only through a reviewed PR, with the reason. 'acknowledged' lists commits that need no merged PR; it never excuses a force push, history rewrite or other ref update, even onto that commit. 'acknowledgedActivity' lists single, already-reviewed updates of main from GitHub's repository activity log, by their activity id, so one entry can never cover a later update.

acknowledged.reason: Initial commit created with the repository by Joshua Small on 2026-10-22, before any pull request existed.

acknowledgedActivity.reason: Creation of main with the initial commit on 2026-10-22, read from GET /repos/WasteOfADrumBum/one-small-engineering/activity.
